summary: NBA opening week: rosters reshuffled by big moves (LeBron and Jaylen Brown in Philadelphia, Giannis in Miami, Mitchell Robinson to Boston, Lillard back in Portland), so last season's numbers misjudge several roles. Spurs start Harper over Champagnie; Clippers open without Beal, Strus and Ingram; Franz Wagner is questionable for Orlando.

CFB-week.summary: Three small Tuesday games. South Alabama (4-2) visits a Marshall team that has allowed about 447 yards and 34 points a game, with Marshall's own quarterback job unsettled after Zion Turner relieved Carlos Del Rio-Wilson against Coastal Carolina. Delaware may again be without starting QB Nick Minicucci, and no player props were posted for Missouri State-Delaware; FIU is a 10-point favorite over MTSU in a 45.5 total.

NBA-ATL-at-ORL-1021.summary: Orlando opens at home against Atlanta with Franz Wagner listed questionable after leaving the Oct 16 preseason finale with right shoulder soreness and doing only light work Sunday; Penda (hamstring) is out and Anthony Black (ankle) is still ramping up. That thins Orlando's creation around Banchero. Atlanta's frontcourt is short with Veesaar (ACL) and Gueye (foot) out, leaving Okongwu, Landale and rookie Ejiofor.

NBA-BOS-at-DET-1020.summary: Boston opens its first season without Jaylen Brown at Detroit; Tatum is fully available after last season's Achilles return, with no minutes limit reported, and Devin Carter (mono) is Boston's only absence. Market has this near a pick'em with a total around 221.5, and previews expect Detroit's top-tier defense to load up on Tatum, which may tilt him toward playmaking and rebounding over scoring.

NBA-CHI-at-TOR-1021.summary: Toronto is healthy and Kawhi Leonard (27.9 ppg last season, about 32 minutes expected) steps into Brandon Ingram's starting spot, adding a high-usage scorer next to Barnes, Barrett and Quickley. Chicago is without Nic Claxton, so Jalen Smith or Tobe Awaka start at center and rookie Caleb Wilson joins the frontcourt; Toronto is about an 8.5-point favorite with a 236.5 total.

NBA-GS-at-LAL-1022.summary: The Lakers open without LeBron James, who left for Philadelphia, making Reaves the clear No. 2 creator beside Doncic; LA is about a 7.5-point favorite with a total near 230.5. Golden State is short-handed (Butler, Moody, Porzingis out), Curry practiced fully after a minor ankle tweak, and Podziemski is questionable after missing Monday practice with lower back soreness.

NBA-MIN-at-MIA-1021.summary: Miami opens the Giannis-Bam era against a Minnesota team built around LaMelo Ball and Anthony Edwards; Bam Adebayo (groin) returned to practice Sunday and expects to play but no final call yet. Finch plans to play Ball and Edwards together, pushing McDaniels toward a third-option role, and Edwards is still regaining movement after last season's knee injuries. Market has Miami about -1.5 with a total in the low 240s.

NBA-OKC-at-SA-1021.summary: Mitch Johnson confirmed a three-guard start (Fox, Castle, Harper with Vassell and Wembanyama), so Julian Champagnie is not starting as the packet assumed; Tobias Harris (calf) is out. OKC returns its core with Jalen Williams and Ajay Mitchell healthy, but Dort, Joe and Wiggins are gone, opening more minutes for Wallace, Mitchell and McCain.

NBA-PHI-at-NY-1020.summary: Ring night for the champion Knicks against a rebuilt Sixers team (LeBron James, Jaylen Brown added) whose stars barely played together in preseason. Mitchell Robinson left New York for Boston, so Towns, Hart and Drummond carry the Knicks' rebounding; Hart (ankle soreness) is expected to play. Nurse plans to manage LeBron's workload (foot arthritis) and Philadelphia's backup center spot is thin with Hukporti out for the season and Bona questionable.

NBA-PHX-at-POR-1022.summary: Portland debuts Ja Morant with Damian Lillard back from his Achilles tear; Nori hinted the starters will be Morant, Lillard, Camara, Avdija and Clingan, so Avdija loses some of the creation he had last season. Jrue Holiday's hand soreness is not expected to affect the opener. Phoenix has Ighodaro (hip) and Kennard (knee) as game-time decisions and Mark Williams out.

NBA-SAC-at-LAC-1022.summary: The Clippers open thin: Beal (knee), Strus (foot) and Konan Niederhauser are out, leaving Garland and Hachimura as the main scorers in a short rotation with Dunn, Jones Jr. and Isaiah Jackson. Sacramento lost Ben Simmons to an Achilles tear and is without centers Raynaud and Cardwell, with Malik Monk doubtful, so its lineup is in flux after an 0-5 preseason.

fix.summary: Quick checks on unresearched Top-10 picks. Curry is cleared to play (full practice). Gui Santos is set to start, which works against his rebound under. Harper's promotion adds a ball-handler next to Fox. Others are healthy with no role change. Posted lines checked on Covers match the app where found.

NFL-WAS-at-SF-1020.summary: Washington is without RB1 Croskey-Merritt (groin), so White and Ekeler split the backfield and previews expect Daniels, back from a two-game elbow absence with 9 carries for 103 yards last week, to carry more of the run game. San Francisco is missing Bosa, Samuel, safety Sigle and LB Wallow; Mike Evans (ribs, calf) did not practice all week and is a game-time call, pushing targets toward Kittle against a Washington defense that is among the worst versus tight ends. Line SF -7.5; total moved from 49.5 lookahead to 52.5 (some books 51.5); forecast low-to-high 60s with 8-12 mph wind, gusts near…

best.why: Josh Hart is probable after full practice Monday, with the ankle soreness costing him only the preseason finale. Mitchell Robinson's move to Boston and Philadelphia's thin frontcourt leave more defensive rebounds for him; the stats lean over and the line has held at 7.5 with the book slightly favoring the over.
